appDescription.message: Paste Markdown, tidy it up, and copy it.

hideSourceTitle.message: Close the editor and show the preview across the whole window

showSourceTitle.message: Open the editor next to the preview

copyMarkdownTitle.message: Copy the editor text exactly as it is

copyRichTitle.message: Copy with the preview's formatting, for pasting into email, chat, and similar apps

copySelectionTitle.message: Copy only the range selected in the editor, with formatting (available when a range is selected)

downloadTitle.message: Download the editor text as an .md file (the file stays on your PC)

clearTitle.message: Erase the editor text and the undo history

notSavedDetail.message: Closing or reloading this tab discards your text. To keep it, copy or download it.

previewEmptySub.message: Paste or type in the editor, and the formatted result appears here.

fenceDetected.message: The whole text is wrapped in a Markdown code fence.

fenceApplied.message: Showing the content without the outer fence (the editor text is unchanged).

manualLarge.message: Automatic updates are paused because the text is large ($1 characters).

manualSlow.message: Automatic updates are paused because conversion is slow.

renderFailed.message: The preview could not be created. Your editor text is still intact.

removedHtml.message: $1 disallowed HTML element(s) are not shown.

imagesReplaced.message: $1 image(s) are not loaded and are shown as alternative text.

copiedImages.message: $1 image(s) were replaced with alternative text.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Your content is unchanged. Please try again.

selectionRequired.message: Select a range in the editor first

downloaded.message: Downloaded. The file is saved on your PC.

clearConfirmBody.message: This erases the editor text, the preview, and the undo history. It cannot be undone.

aboutPrivacy.message: Your text is never saved automatically or sent anywhere. Only your settings are saved (default extra syntax and formatted paste).

fmtMoreTitle.message: More formatting (italic, strikethrough, quote, image, horizontal rule)

syntaxIntro.message: Checked syntax is interpreted in this tab's preview and formatted copy. The editor text is not changed.

featureAlertsHelp.message: > [!NOTE] at the top of a quote shows it as a note box.

featureFootnotesHelp.message: Text[^1] and [^1]: note collect notes at the end.

featureMathHelp.message: $1 and $2 are kept apart from other syntax and shown as text. Formulas are not drawn.

featureContainersHelp.message: Text between ::: note and ::: is shown in a box.

featureWikiLinksHelp.message: [[page]] and [[page|label]] are shown as links (they do not open, because the browser cannot open your files).

featureDefinitionListsHelp.message: A term followed by a line starting with : shows a term and its description.

saveDefault.message: Save as the default for new tabs

syntaxSaved.message: Saved as the default for new tabs

syntaxSaveFailed.message: Could not save the default. It is applied to this tab.

selectionOutside.message: Link or footnote definitions outside the selection are not included.

pasteHtmlHelp.message: Brings in formatting such as headings, bold, lists, and tables. When this is off, only the text is pasted, without formatting.

pasteNote.message: Markdown and text without formatting are pasted as they are. Some formatting, such as text color and fonts, is not carried over.

pasteConverted.message: Formatted text was converted to Markdown and pasted

pasteHint.message: Formatted text was pasted as plain text. Turn on the setting to bring in its formatting too.

pasteSaveFailed.message: Could not save the paste settings

pasteTooLong.message: The content is long, so it was pasted without its formatting
